inputs.original_text: They’re pushing Terry Pheto and the alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal into the spotlight, but that may be the point: give the public one recognizable face to focus on while the institutions involved shape what gets said and what stays hidden. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026. A briefing and an SIU probe don’t tell us the whole story—and the more they insist this is about one person, the more I’d ask whose interests that framing serves.
inputs.modified_text: They’re making Terry Pheto the face of an alleged R20.56 million National Lotteries Commission scandal, and that feels less like transparency than a carefully managed distraction. The claims surfaced at the Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, but a briefing and an SIU probe are still institutions telling the public what they want it to hear. If everyone keeps steering attention toward one person, the real question is who benefits from keeping the institutions—and whatever they may be hiding—out of focus.
